title: Relative Velocity
notes: **Relative velocity:** the velocity of one object measured with respect to another moving object.
**Same direction:** if car A moves at $v_A$ and car B at $v_B$ in the same direction, A sees B moving at $v_{B/A} = v_B - v_A$.
**Opposite direction:** if they move toward each other, the relative speed is the sum: $v_{rel} = v_A + v_B$.
**Vector form:** $\vec{v}_{B/A} = \vec{v}_B - \vec{v}_A$. The velocity of B relative to A equals B's velocity in the ground frame minus A's velocity in the ground frame.
**Rain example:** if rain falls vertically at $v_r$ and you run horizontally at $v_p$, the rain appears to come at you at an angle $\theta$ where $\tan\theta = v_p / v_r$.
